the development of a new generation of electro-optical modulators and receivers based on the interaction between whispering gallery modes and the electric field of an electromagnetic wave.
the design of a novel electro-optical modulator based on a whispering gallery mode disk resonator.
the development of novel optical devices for applications in the radio-to-optical domain.
